gitCommit.subject: feat(purses-9hl): slug + number URLs for sessions & results (no raw ULIDs) (#197)
gitCommit.body:
feat(purses-9hl): slug + number URLs for sessions & results (no raw ULIDs) (#197)

* docs(purses-9hl): implementation plan for slug+number URLs

* docs(purses-9hl): fold adversarial-review findings into plan (CONCERNS, no BLOCK)

* docs(purses-9hl): scope decision R9 — sessions-only Task 5; sort-results work -> purses-axn

* feat(purses-9hl): add number column + unique index to sessions & sort_results

* feat(purses-9hl): Session/SortResult.number type + findByCollectionAndNumber interface

* feat(purses-9hl): SessionRepository number allocation + findByCollectionAndNumber

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(purses-9hl): SortResultRepository number allocation + findByCollectionAndNumber

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(purses-9hl): allocate session number via repo on /api/sessions POST

* feat(purses-9hl): idempotent backfill for session & result numbers

One-shot backfill assigns per-collection sequential numbers (1..n by
createdAt, asc(id) tiebreaker) to existing sessions and sort_results rows
whose number is NULL. Idempotent (WHERE number IS NULL, continues past MAX).
Folded into vercel-build so the prod null-number window cannot be forgotten.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(purses-9hl): resolve sort sessions by number; keep #196 guard; ULID to clients

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(purses-9hl): drop eslint-disable for unregistered no-explicit-any rule in alloc tests

Deleted 5 instances of // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
from SessionRepository.alloc.test.ts (2) and SortResultRepository.alloc.test.ts (3).
The no-explicit-any rule is not registered in this project's ESLint config, so the
disable comments were themselves lint errors. The as any[][] casts remain and lint
cleanly without the comments.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(purses-9hl): resolve results by number; finalize redirects by number; keep guards

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(purses-9hl): create/complete generators emit slug + number

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(purses-9hl): list + dashboard nav links use slug and number

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(purses-9hl): compare guard test, active-session links, R5 selectWhere count (final-review fixes)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(purses-9hl): e2e triage navigates by session number after route rename

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
